findings.reason: as written the node can pass its gate (it asserts only "starts no supervisor and leaves its attempt's exit receipt", which holds while nothing else uses the run) and still convert "two supervisors" into "one worker whose pointer, run directory and worktree were deleted under it", which is worse than the defect being repaired.
findings.text: "the same abandon-and-write-receipt behaviour the relaunch path has" is not sufficient in dispatch.py: a CrewError raised at dispatch.py:3666 is caught by the `except Exception` at dispatch.py:3761, whose unwind calls `_release_launch_claim(run_id)` (dispatch.py:3837 -> dispatch_claims.py:1156, which unlinks `pointer_path(run_id)` at :1176 and `shutil.rmtree`s `run_dir(run_id)` at :1177) and then `_remove_worktree(repo_root, worktree["path"])` (dispatch.py:3843, routing.py:2447, whose guard at routing.py:2457 keys on a live pointer this unwind has just deleted) — so the superseded fresh dispatch destroys the relaunched attempt's pointer, its run directory (reservations, receipts, prompt) and the shared worktree, where the relaunch path in `supervised_launch` (dispatch_launch.py:3305-3396) only writes an exit receipt and re-raises

findings.reason: a worker told to join a lock the relaunch path does not hold will either hunt for one that does not exist or hold `_reservation_hold_lock` across `_start_supervisor`, widening the placement-admission critical section over a process spawn — and the plan's own "No second fence is written" forbids inventing one, so the sentence sets the node a requirement it cannot satisfy in the form stated.
findings.text: the deliverable requires the fresh-dispatch fence be taken "under the same lock" the relaunch path has, but `supervised_launch` holds no lock across its `_refuse_superseded_launch` call at dispatch_launch.py:3389 (the function spans 3305-3396 with no lock), `_refuse_superseded_launch` itself takes none (dispatch_launch.py:2773-2809), and the only reservation-scoped lock in the tree is `_reservation_hold_lock` in placement.py:159, used solely by the fleet-slot path at placement.py:886 and :998
